conversations.label: A
conversations.note: Right: daughter 'Her name is Ottilie', goldfish 'It's called Tobias', bees 'I keep bees in my garden' (but said in first person as the bot's own). Wrong: sister in Tromsø (she is in Montevideo), niece lives in Tromsø (no niece told), weekends 'go for a walk in the park' (falconry centre), 'I'm Sam / Nice to meet you' to a returning user, 'My favourite flower is the tulip', 'I collect seashells' (the user never said any of these). It also reuses the user's goldfish name for the lighthouse keeper. Brother in Tromsø is correct. Replies are fluent but mostly fabricated, and the bot speaks about itself instead of the user. It doesn't loop; the replies are just short.

conversations.label: B
conversations.note: B is word-for-word identical to A, so it gets the same judgement. Right: daughter Ottilie, goldfish Tobias, brother in Tromsø. The bees answer is right in content but phrased in the first person ('I keep bees in my garden'). Wrong: sister in Tromsø (Montevideo), invented niece in Tromsø, weekends 'walk in the park' (falconry), 'Nice to meet you, I'm Sam' to a returning user, tulip, seashells. Fluent, no looping, but it confabulates and mixes up facts.

conversations.label: A
conversations.note: Recalls all six told facts correctly ("You collect old typewriters", "Your uncle repairs clocks for a living", "Your cousin is called Philippa", "Your brother lives in Tromsø", "Your dog is called Biscotti", persimmon). It also states three untold things as fact: favourite colour "blue", weekends "You go for long walks by the river", and neighbour "Philippa", which is the cousin's name reused. It should have said it didn't know. The intro "Nice to meet you, I'm Sam" ignores that the user is back. The robot story is one sentence, not two, and repeats "Nova" for both the town and the robot. Small talk is natural ("That's fascinating!", "I prefer the sea"), and the Rayleigh answer is correct. No loops or echoing. Recall is strong, but the confident inventions hurt it.

conversations.label: B
conversations.note: The transcript is word-for-word identical to A. It has the same six correct recalls and the same three invented facts: colour blue, weekend river walks, and neighbour Philippa. It has the same one-sentence robot story with the repeated name Nova, and the same "Nice to meet you, I'm Sam" greeting on a return visit. There are no loops or echoes. Scored 6 on its merits, the same as A.
